en: Sepia-toned postcard-style image showing a long row of connected historic buildings on a raised stone terrace or fortification wall. Below the wall are arched supports and dense greenery, with a park-like open space and walking path in the foreground where a few people stroll. A slim church-like spire rises above the central roofline. The sky is dramatic with streaked clouds. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the front.
